description:
The Missile Defense Agency (MDA) “Launcher” solicitation seeks prototype proposals (10 USC 4022) related to the design, fabrication, testing, and demonstration of a novel launch system.

Documents up to the SECRET classification are necessary to respond to this solicitation. These documents will be provided at the request of potential offerors with an active SECRET (or higher) FCL with SECRET (or higher) Safeguarding Level.  

For documents related to this request for prototype proposal, please contact: mda.ab-launchers@mail.smil.mil.

Included in your request, please provide company name, company/division address, CAGE code, unique identifier number, company point of contact for delivery (name, email and phone number), and mailing address (if different than company/division address).

This solicitation is posted under MDA's Nimble Options for Buying Layered Effects (NOBLE) Announcement, Solicitation No. HQ0860-25-S-0001.
